Name: Zimmah, Son of Jahath
Summary: Son of Jahath and father of Joah in Gershom's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:20: Son of Jahath and father of Joah in Gershom's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zimmah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
